## Publication Information

**Date:** 1858-1860

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> (July 1858-December 1860)

**Notes:** A series of scientific articles which appeared intermittently.  CMY told Alexander Macmillan in 1866 that they were written by a sister of Arthur Rawson Ashwell's.
